versions.changelog:
FIFA World Cup 2026 support and data improvements.

- Added full internal coverage for all FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, venues, and group tables (no API key required for national teams).
- National teams from World Cup 2026 can be tracked by name only, with localized output for pt-BR.
- Next match blocks now include venue (with 🏟️) when available.
- World Cup schedules, standings, and knockout rounds are handled internally using new data files.
- Lookup and output logic updated to prioritize World Cup teams and enhanced summary structure.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (skill-card.md).

football-tracker 1.1.3

- Improved first-use flow: now clearly asks for an API key and handles setup internally.
- Kickoff timestamps now always include the weekday.
- News filtering improved: excludes non-football topics like base teams, futsal, rowing, basketball, and women's sections.
- Messaging and setup instructions made clearer; fallback compatibility for old API key format is still supported silently.
- Teams from Premier League and Brazilian League are alredy in the database by default
- General bug fixes and discovery enhancements.

football-tracker 1.1.2

- News results now filter out previews, lineups, kickoff-time posts, and where-to-watch articles.
- A localized beta notice and current version are appended to every result.
- Additional notes document bug fixes and discovery improvements in this release.

- Major refactor with a new bilingual system and expanded output details.
- English and Portuguese localizations are now supported via language packs.
- Added kickoff time (with timezone), next match broadcasters, and improved output formatting.
- Removed most old code, configs, and service files in favor of a new structure.
- Usage and output instructions have been updated and clarified in the documentation.

Initial release with core football tracking features:

- Track multiple football teams and receive emoji-formatted summaries.
- Returns last match, next match, league standing, and latest news for each team.
- Integrates with football-data.org via API key.
- Includes internal caching, team resolution, and news aggregation functionality.
- No extra Python packages required.

Initial release of Football Tracker AI.

- Permite acompanhar informações sobre qualquer time de futebol do mundo.
- Exibe último jogo, próxima partida, campeonato, posição na tabela, fase da competição e últimas notícias.
- Fácil de usar: basta informar o time para obter as novidades.
